notes: Ground truth lives in `expected` and is compared as a SUBSET: a fixture asserts only
the fields the interruption was meant to change, so preserved fields cannot false-fail.
interrupt_phase=speaking -> user barges into audible Rime speech (stale audio is the risk).
interrupt_phase=tool     -> user changes intent while a slow tool is in flight (stale RESULT is the risk).
Latencies here are scenario inputs. See results/*.json 'assumptions' for what is modelled vs measured.
naive_expected=defect -> the control arm MUST reproduce the stale-output bug or the fixture is not discriminating; naive_expected=clean -> both arms must stay clean (false-positive guard).
